args.message: For each order I took the amount and subtracted the ordering customer's discount as a flat value, then summed by region and tier. The last column repeats the total for the whole region on each row. Orders with no matching customer are left out. Customers with no known region are grouped under null; only silver-tier customers fall in that group. No matched customer has a missing discount, so no orders dropped out of the sums.
